dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline on the trailing edge with moderate curvature from the posterior insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a small pixel radius at the terminal dorsal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear incline measured at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical height to maximum base width ratio of approximately 1.1:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex semi-circular arc with a consistent curvature radius defining the forehead profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust protrusion with a low length-to-thickness ratio extending from the melon base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the transition point between the descending melon slope and the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear dark scar on the upper flank posterior to the blowhole region; mottled depigmentation/patchy texture at the anterior base of the dorsal fin; small dark punctate lesions on the lateral mid-body.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharp contrast boundary between dark dorsal and bright white ventral-lateral pigmentation; prominent specular highlight on the mid-lateral flank.
